Hymn 244: Come Along, Come Along
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: William B. Bradbury

This is hymn number 244 titled "Come Along, Come Along" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William B. Bradbury and the lyrics were written by William Willes.
